# ops_vcs_connection (Data Source)

A VCS connection, by name: e.g. to publish registry modules or connect the template catalog with a connection made in the UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A connection made in the UI
data "ops_vcs_connection" "github" {
  name = "github"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `base_url` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `provider_type` (String)
- `scope` (String)
